The Game

Enter the World of Nesloke

Kickstarter — Coming August 2026

In a world where 1 in 500 people are born with extraordinary power, the balance between the gifted and the ordinary has never been more fragile. Seven types of Potezen walk among the people of Nesloke, each carrying a gift. Each carrying a burden.

Nesloke is an original tabletop roleplaying game built from the ground up. Play as one of seven Potezen archetypes and wield power that shapes the world around you, or choose from five Non-Potezen archetypes and prove that skill, discipline, and will can stand against anything.

The Novel

Siege of Shanderon

Step into the world of Nesloke through the eyes of Contier, a Mover and son of the King of Shanderon. Siege of Shanderon is an original novel set within the world of Nesloke, bringing its people, powers, and conflicts to life on the page.
